item.title: IT Systems Operations Engineer
item.description:
Architecting and maintaining enterprise infrastructure, implementing automation strategies, and driving operational excellence across cloud and on-premises environments.

I design and implement workflow automations, improve access management and onboarding/offboarding processes, and support large-scale cloud operations. My work spans MDM platforms (Intune, Kandji), identity systems (Okta, Azure AD, Active Directory, Workday), and collaboration tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Jira) to support distributed teams across the global organization.

I maintain hands-on expertise in network infrastructure, SD-WAN/SDN, VPN systems, and A/V conferencing solutions, with a consistent focus on compliance, security, and user productivity. I build strong vendor relationships and cross-functional partnerships with Finance, Security, and People teams to enable scalable, reliable, and secure operations.

item.title: Sr. Technical Support Analyst
item.description:
As the sole in-house IT administrator at Praedicat, I was fully responsible for managing and maintaining the company’s IT infrastructure across multiple locations. My role combined hands-on technical support with long-term infrastructure planning, ensuring system reliability, security, and scalability for a growing organization.

I led the procurement, deployment, and lifecycle management of hardware, including desktops, laptops, servers, and network equipment. I managed inventory, vendor coordination, and internal asset tracking while supporting all staff with technical troubleshooting and end-user support across macOS, Windows, and Linux systems.

item.title: IT Engineer
item.description: I served as a Senior Systems Administrator and Network Security Administrator. I was responsible for securing and maintaining a high-traffic infrastructure across multiple regions. My role involved leading internal security audits, working closely with white-hat teams for penetration testing, and deploying monitoring tools to ensure real-time visibility and threat detection. I coordinated system patching, managed disaster recovery plans, and maintained reliable backups for operational resilience. Additionally, I resolved complex network issues, deployed antivirus and asset management agents across environments, and ensured all systems met security and compliance standards. My work directly supported the stability and scalability of a distributed infrastructure serving thousands of affiliates worldwide

item.title: Systems Administrator
item.description:
T3Leads is the world’s premier online lead generation firm and affiliate network. T3Leads’ expertise is in providing quality payday loan leads, as the go-to pay-per-lead affiliate network for the financial sector. With over 10,000 active affiliates, T3Leads currently operates in the US, UK, Canada, and Australia.

As a Senior Systems Administrator & Network Security Administrator at T3Leads, my responsibilities include: Network Security • Ensuring system security, spearheading security audits, and working with the Hi Level White Hackers team for penetration testing • Utilizing security tools to monitor the networks and reporting and responding immediately to security or usability issues and incidents • Writing custom monitoring plugins to ensure system security • Coordinating and installing patches and releases on web applications and development, pre production, and production systems • Diagnosing and resolving network connectivity interruptions, including malware infections, faulty hardware, and configuration issues • Implementing functional backup plans and disaster recovery plans • Scheduling, creating, and verifying backups on a regular and ad hoc basis • Deploying backup, antivirus, monitoring, blade logic, and asset management agents as servers are added into the network • Hands on experience with computer forensics, penetration and vulnerability testing tools, and conducting internal audits, vulnerability scanning, firewall, penetration testing • Install, diagnose, repair, and upgrade all hardware, applications and equipment, including regulation of any software incidents

item.title: Software Engineer
item.description:
T3Leads, the leading provider of online lead generation and affiliate network services, specializes in delivering top-notch payday loan leads to the financial industry. With a thriving network of over 10,000 active affiliates, the company operates globally, serving clients in the US, UK, Canada, and Australia.

As a PHP Developer at T3Leads, I was responsible for using a variety of technologies to create websites and web applications, and developing user-friendly front- and back-end interfaces using HTML, PHP, CSS, and JavaScript. I was able to work independently with minimal supervision, maintaining a close working relationship with the Executive team.

item.title: Legal Counsel
item.description:
Worked in the company’s legal department, preparing and reviewing commercial real estate lease agreements for properties in Moscow and the Moscow region. Participated as part of a team responsible for legal support of lease transactions, including contract analysis, due-diligence of counterparties, and negotiating terms with landlords.

The work was project-based and performed in parallel with my IT responsibilities, combining legal expertise with technical operations to support the organization’s business development and risk management.

item.title: Director
item.description:
Led a real estate agency, managing a team of agents and overseeing transactions for both private and corporate clients. Supervised the full transaction cycle — from property selection and client consultation to contract signing.

Worked with mortgage providers and partner organizations, and developed investment and shared-construction (equity participation) projects. Ensured legal compliance, due diligence, and high-quality customer service throughout all operations.

Key contributions:

Managed real estate agency operations and team of agents

item.title: Real Estate Agent, Director
item.description:
Started as a real estate agent and, together with a business partner, secured investors and strengthened the company’s position in the local market. Provided clients with a full range of real estate services, including property sales, purchases, and rentals. Trained new agents and developed service quality standards.

Later became the agency’s director and served as President of the Guild of Real Estate Agents of Yurga, where I organized charitable initiatives and supported local orphanages. Also participated in national real estate conferences in Moscow and Saint Petersburg.

item.title: Non-Ferrous Metals Intake Specialist
item.description:
Accepted non-ferrous metals from the public, identified material types and quality, performed weighing, and calculated purchase value. Responsible for receiving, storing, and transferring materials, as well as handling cash operations. Served as a financially accountable employee.

The work was part of a social and charitable program supporting people with disabilities and those affected by the Chernobyl disaster, combining technical expertise with community service.

Key contributions:

Accepted and processed non-ferrous metals from public

item.title: Machinist / Lathe Operator
item.description:
Worked on a universal 16K20 lathe and two STP-220AP CNC machines. Programmed and operated turning equipment, performed machine setup, and ensured precision control throughout the machining process. Manufactured components for the hydraulic systems of forklifts produced at the plant during that period.

Operated the STP-220AP CNC lathe equipped with the NC-210 control system, CSD feed drives, and DELTA main drive. Performed setup, tooling adjustments, and execution of precision turning programs. Read technical drawings, verified dimensions, and ensured machining accuracy.
